maddeler.e:
نحترم (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِمُ (naḥtarimu) /naħ.ta.ri.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# نُحْتَرَمُ (nuḥtaramu) /nuħ.ta.ra.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# نَحْتَرِمَ (naḥtarima) /naħ.ta.ri.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# نُحْتَرَمَ (nuḥtarama) /nuħ.ta.ra.ma/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
